message.content: What is the application version? Do not add parameters!

function.name: version_api_VersionApi_get_version
function.description: Retrieve the current version of the application, including the application name and its semantic versioning string. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

function.name: repository_api_RepositoryApi_get_repository_meta_component
function.description: Resolves the latest version of a component based on its Package URL from the configured repositories. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

purl.description: The Package URL (purl) uniquely identifying the component whose latest version needs to be resolved.

function.name: oidc_api_OidcApi_is_available
function.description: Check whether OpenID Connect authentication is available for the specified application. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

app_id.description: The unique identifier of the application to check for OpenID Connect availability.
